versions.changelog:
Initial release of douyin-video-words with powerful video-to-text and content extraction for Douyin videos.

- Supports intelligent speech transcription for Douyin video links or local files, covering Mandarin, Cantonese, and various dialects/foreign languages.
- Uses a large language model to generate clean transcripts: removes filler words, mistakes, repetitions, and delivers ready-to-use copy.
- Custom prompts enable one-click creation of summaries, rewrites for different styles (e.g., Xiaohongshu), highlights, segmented scripts, and translations.
- Handles both online (public URL) and local video/audio files.
- Outputs clean text to stdout for easy integration; logs and progress to stderr.
- Secure, privacy-respecting processing; requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN setup before use.
